newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga plans Vigdis oil restart on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Saga plans Vigdis oil restart on Wednesday.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Tuesday it planned to restart oil production at the North Sea Vigdis field on Wednesday and gas would begin to flow two days later.
Last Thursday the company said it would resume operations at Vigdis on July 7.
"The plan is to start oil production on Wednesday and gas production on Friday," a spokeswoman for the company said. "All the repairs are completed."
The restart of Vigdis has been delayed since the end of June. The development was closed down on May 23 after a gas leak was detected in the compressor train, which was traced back to a design fault.
Vigdis, which came on stream in January five months ahead of schedule, suffered an unscheduled shutdown on April 15 due to other problems with the gas compressor. The field was restarted on May 16.
Output was around 50,000 barrels per day (bpd) before the latest incident, but peak output is planned to reach around 75,000 bpd.
Saga will close the field down again for maintenance between August 25 and September 19 to coincide with a scheduled turnaround at the Gullfaks A platform.
